entities.summary: The Maluwe Mosque is a mosque located on the Bole road in the West Gonja District in the Savannah region of Ghana. Maluwe is a small village east of Bui National Park. Maluwe Mosque is a mosque in Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
